inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 16th February, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) warned today of active to occasionally strong northwesterly winds, raising dust and sand and reducing horizontal visibility to less than 3,000 metres in some coastal and inland areas. The Centre stated in a statement issued today that the weather conditions began at 10:30 and will continue until 18:00, urging the public to exercise caution, particularly when driving on external and open roads, due to the risk of sudden drops in visibility caused by blowing dust.

requested_area.areaDesc: Coastal and inland areas, Abu Dhabi (demo zone)

fields.description: EXERCISE - Strong northwesterly winds are raising dust and sand. Visibility is below 3,000 m in some coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi until 18:00 today, 16 Feb. Visibility can drop suddenly.
fields.headline: EXERCISE: Blowing dust and low visibility in coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi until 18:00
fields.instruction: Drive with caution, especially on external and open roads, and be ready for sudden drops in visibility. Updates: https://alerts.example.ae
fields.note_for_reviewer: The source gives 10:30 to 18:00 without a time zone, so I assumed local UAE time and kept '18:00 today, 16 Feb'. The source says visibility is below 3,000 m only in 'some' areas, not across the whole demo zone, and I rated severity as Moderate based on that; please confirm both.

versions.description: تمرين - رياح شمالية غربية قوية تثير الغبار والرمال. مدى الرؤية أقل من 3,000 م في بعض المناطق الساحلية والداخلية من أبوظبي حتى الساعة 18:00 اليوم، 16 فبراير. قد ينخفض مدى الرؤية بشكل مفاجئ.
versions.headline: تمرين: غبار متطاير وانخفاض في مدى الرؤية في المناطق الساحلية والداخلية من أبوظبي حتى الساعة 18:00
versions.instruction: قُد بحذر، خاصة على الطرق الخارجية والمفتوحة، وكن مستعداً لانخفاض مفاجئ في مدى الرؤية. التحديثات: https://alerts.example.ae

objections.fix: Reword to 'Active to occasionally strong northwesterly winds are raising dust and sand.'
objections.issue: The alert says 'Strong northwesterly winds', but the bulletin says 'active to occasionally strong'. Dropping the qualifier raises the stated wind intensity above what the bulletin supports.

objections.fix: Use the bulletin's wording: 'some coastal and inland areas'. Name Abu Dhabi only if NCM confirms that area. Add 'some' to the headline.
objections.issue: The alert places the hazard in 'coastal and inland areas of Abu Dhabi'. The bulletin only says 'some coastal and inland areas', and Abu Dhabi appears only in the dateline. The headline also drops 'some', which makes the affected area look wider than the bulletin states.

fields.description: EXERCISE - this is a drill. Active to occasionally strong northwesterly winds are raising dust and sand. Visibility is below 3,000 m in some coastal and inland areas until 18:00 today (16 Feb). Visibility can drop suddenly.

left_out: No unverified inputs were received, so nothing was left out for that reason.

Abu Dhabi is not named as the affected area. It appears only in the bulletin's dateline, and the Met office reviewer asked that it be named only if NCM confirms it. The operator's demo target area is used for delivery only.
'Strong northwesterly winds' was replaced with the bulletin's wording, 'active to occasionally strong', at the Met office reviewer's request.
fields.note_for_reviewer: Abu Dhabi has been removed from the headline and text even though the operator's target zone is Abu Dhabi. Please confirm that the broadcast area matches NCM's 'some coastal and inland areas'. The bulletin gives no time zone; 10:30-18:00 on 16 Feb 2026 is assumed to be UAE local time, and the alert is sent as Moderate/Immediate/Observed because the conditions had already begun.
